title: Eat Up!
description: Feeling peckish? Or maybe you're just longing to regenerate some of that health you've lost. Well, the solution is simple. In this world, eating directly restores health. No hunger bar to speak of. The amount of health restored is based on the food's original hunger values. Keep in mind that while you can regenerate most of the time, natural regeneration is disabled during combat.
